prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Kael, the SAME human boy from the reference image. Use reference column3 top and bottom for his RIGHT-facing appearance and outfit. Create EXACTLY EIGHT fully drawn full-body animation frames of a NATURAL WALK TO THE RIGHT (east). All frames right-facing profile, same face, dark blue spiky hair, open blue jacket over charcoal T-shirt turquoise neckline, rolled blue shorts, dark navy shoes with ochre soles, small navy backpack with ochre diamond badge. Keep the compact chibi proportions of reference, NOT a taller doll body. Style polished small 2D illustrated sprites with dark outlines and controlled warm cel shading; no 3D, no separated body parts.

TECHNICAL LAYOUT: horizontal landscape 2048x1024 PNG, 4 columns x2 rows, EXACT cell512x512. Each character centered at x256 in its cell with foot contact baseline y448, head top around y80. All eight characters same scale, stable torso, stable size/shape of head and backpack. Fully transparent background, no shadows drawn outside character, no ground line, no numbers/text/grid. Do not overlap cell boundaries. Each cell ONE complete character. Read frames left to right row1 then row2.

ANIMATION: eight DIFFERENT consecutive poses spanning ONE FULL WALK CYCLE, NOT eight copies, NOT 4 poses duplicated. In all poses anatomy connected and shoulders natural, elbows and knees bend.
Frame1: near LEFT foot forward heel contact, far right foot backward toe contact; near arm back, far arm forward.
Frame2: down/recoil, near left foot planted ahead with knee flexed, far right heel lifted behind; torso down slightly.
Frame3: passing pose, left foot supports under hips, far right knee passes forward with lifted foot; arms pass down by torso.
Frame4: up pose, left foot heel raised supporting body, right knee advances and right foot prepares to extend; body up slightly.
Frame5: opposite contact, near LEFT foot behind on toe, far right foot forward heel contact; near arm forward, far arm back.
Frame6: opposite down/recoil, right planted foot flexes, left heel lifts behind; torso down slightly.
Frame7: opposite passing, right leg supports, near left knee passes forward and left foot lifted; arms pass torso.
Frame8: opposite up, right heel raised supporting body, left knee advances ready to contact at frame1.
Do NOT repeat frame1 as frame8. Keep contact foot bottoms at y448, head vertical bob only 3 to 6px, no scaling or facial changes. Emphasize natural opposed arm swing and planted feet, true profile no face turning toward camera. Avoid bent mannequin shoulders, separated arms, stiff straight knees, running/leaping poses, big fists pushed forward.
